Our Programs

Three Pillars of Excellence

Whether you're a student, early-career researcher, or senior leader, we have a program designed for your journey.

About Plexus

Plexus is Croatia's premier biomedical conference, bringing together researchers, clinicians, students, and industry leaders from around the world. Now in its 10th year, Plexus features keynote speeches from biomedical leaders, cutting-edge research presentations, and unparalleled networking opportunities.

Join us in December 2026 for two days of inspiring talks, poster sessions, workshops, and the Gala Evening featuring the Biomedical Forum's Annual Awards ceremony.

Key Dates

Exclusive Evening Event

Gala Evening & Awards Ceremony

Saturday, December 5, 2026 — Grand Ballroom, Hotel Esplanade Zagreb

An unforgettable evening celebrating biomedical excellence. Join biomedical leaders, leading researchers, and fellow attendees for the Annual Awards Ceremony, fine dining, and live entertainment. Formal attire required.

About

Discover Zagreb

Croatia's vibrant capital awaits you this December — a city where Austro-Hungarian elegance meets Mediterranean warmth

Zagreb Highlights

The must-see landmarks and experiences during your stay

Ban Jelacic Square

The central square of Zagreb, a vibrant meeting point surrounded by cafes, shops, and historic architecture. The heart of the city since 1850.

City Center 5 min from venue

St. Mark's Church

Famous for its colorful tiled roof displaying the coats of arms of Croatia, Dalmatia, Slavonia, and Zagreb. A Gothic masterpiece in the Upper Town.

Upper Town Must-see

Zagreb Cathedral

The tallest building in Croatia with its iconic twin spires. A stunning example of Neo-Gothic architecture that dominates the city skyline.

Kaptol Open daily

Dolac Market

Zagreb's most famous open-air market, known as the 'Belly of Zagreb'. Fresh produce, local cheeses, and traditional Croatian delicacies.

Local Market Food & Culture

Upper Town (Gornji Grad)

The historic heart of Zagreb with cobblestone streets, the Stone Gate, Lotrscak Tower, and stunning panoramic views of the city below.

Historic District 15 min walk

Museum of Broken Relationships

One of Zagreb's most unique attractions — a museum dedicated to failed love stories and their mementos. Quirky, emotional, and unforgettable.

Unique Museum Top Rated

Jarun Lake

A beautiful recreational area perfect for jogging, cycling, or relaxing by the water. Popular with locals for morning exercise and evening strolls.

Recreation Outdoor

Tkalciceva Street

Zagreb's most popular pedestrian street, lined with cafes, bars, and restaurants. The perfect place to experience Zagreb's famous cafe culture.

Cafe Street Nightlife

Getting Around

Zagreb is compact and easy to navigate

Walkable City Center

Most landmarks, restaurants, and the conference venue are within a 20-minute walk from the main square. Zagreb's compact center is best explored on foot.

Tram Network

Zagreb's blue trams are iconic and efficient. A single ticket costs about 0.50 EUR. Lines run frequently from 4am to midnight. Buy tickets at kiosks or via the ZET app.

Taxis & Rideshare

Bolt and Uber are widely available and affordable. A ride across the city rarely exceeds 8 EUR. From the airport, expect around 15-20 EUR to the city center.

Food & Drink

Croatian cuisine is a delicious crossroads of Central European and Mediterranean flavors

🧀

Strukli

Zagreb's signature dish — baked layers of thin dough filled with fresh cottage cheese and sour cream. Rich, comforting, and utterly addictive.

🍖

Cevapi

Grilled minced meat sausages served with fresh flatbread (lepinja), raw onions, and ajvar (roasted red pepper spread). The Balkan barbecue classic.

🍷

Croatian Wines

Croatia has over 130 indigenous grape varieties. Try Grasevina (white, continental) or Plavac Mali (red, coastal). The wine bars on Tkalciceva Street are excellent.

🍺

Craft Beer Scene

Zagreb's craft beer revolution is in full swing. Visit The Garden Brewery, Zmajska Pivovara, or Nova Runda for world-class local brews in laid-back taprooms.

Explore Croatia

Extend your trip and discover one of Europe's most stunning countries

Plitvice Lakes National Park

A UNESCO World Heritage site and Croatia's crown jewel of natural beauty. Sixteen terraced lakes connected by waterfalls cascade through ancient beech and fir forests. Even in winter, the frozen waterfalls and misty landscapes are breathtaking. Only 2 hours from Zagreb.

2 hour drive UNESCO Site

Dubrovnik

The "Pearl of the Adriatic" needs no introduction. Walk the ancient city walls, explore the UNESCO-listed Old Town, and recognize the filming locations of King's Landing from Game of Thrones. A short domestic flight from Zagreb gets you there in under an hour.

1h flight UNESCO Old Town

Split

Croatia's second-largest city is built in and around the ruins of Roman Emperor Diocletian's Palace — a living, breathing ancient monument. Stroll the Riva promenade, lose yourself in the palace's underground cellars, and soak in the coastal Mediterranean atmosphere.

1h flight Diocletian's Palace

Rovinj

A romantic Istrian coastal gem that feels like stepping into an Italian painting. Pastel-colored houses tumble down a hillside to the sparkling Adriatic, crowned by the Church of St. Euphemia. The surrounding Istrian peninsula is renowned for its truffles, olive oil, and world-class wine.

3 hour drive Istrian Gem

About the Program

The Med&X Accelerator is a prestigious summer research program that places exceptional Croatian students and early-career researchers at world-renowned labs and clinics from institutions including Harvard Medical School, Yale School of Medicine, Mayo Clinic, Cleveland Clinic, MIT, and MGH.

Our mission goes beyond the internship itself. We want participants to experience amazing institutions, develop both professionally and personally, and accelerate their career development. Upon returning to Croatia, alumni transfer their newly acquired knowledge and skills while maintaining collaborations with their host institutions.

This creates a lasting impact: building bridges in biomedicine between Croatia and world-leading institutions, opening doors for future collaborations, joint research projects, and continued professional exchange.

Eligibility: Medical students, graduate students in biomedical sciences, and early-career researchers (0-3 years post-graduation) from Croatia.

Application Process

1

Submit Your Application

Complete the online application form and upload all required documents by the deadline.

2

Document Review

Our selection committee evaluates all applications. Shortlisted candidates advance to the interview round.

3

Interview Round

Shortlisted candidates are interviewed by two Croatian biomedical professionals (from Croatia or abroad).

4

Final Selection & Onboarding

Points are summed, candidates are ranked, and top candidates receive positions. We then assist with fellowship paperwork and onboarding.

Note: Being selected by Med&X does not guarantee placement. The host institution reserves the right to reject any candidate. Final acceptance is subject to institutional approval.

Frequently Asked Questions

To be eligible for the Med&X Accelerator, you must:

  • Be a medical student, graduate student, or recent graduate (within 2 years)
  • Have Croatian citizenship or strong ties to Croatia
  • Demonstrate academic excellence (GPA 3.5+ or equivalent)
  • Show genuine interest in biomedical research
  • Have basic English proficiency (B2 or higher)

We particularly welcome applicants with prior research experience, though it's not strictly required.

The Accelerator provides comprehensive financial support:

  • Stipend: Monthly living allowance of $2,000-3,000 depending on location
  • Travel: Round-trip airfare covered
  • Housing: Assistance with finding accommodation (some institutions provide housing)
  • Visa: Full support with J-1 visa sponsorship and processing fees

You are responsible for personal expenses and health insurance (though we help arrange affordable options).

The Accelerator is highly competitive. For 2025, we received over 150 applications for 29 positions (approximately 19% acceptance rate).

Selection is based on:

  • Academic achievement (30%)
  • Research experience and potential (25%)
  • Motivation letter quality (20%)
  • Interview performance (15%)
  • Recommendation letters (10%)

We value diversity of backgrounds and research interests, so don't be discouraged if you're from a smaller institution.

The 2026 program timeline:

  • Jan 15: Applications open
  • Mar 31: Application deadline
  • Apr 1-15: Document review
  • Apr 20 - May 10: Interviews (online)
  • May 15: Final decisions announced
  • Jun - Aug: Summer research program

We strongly encourage early submission to avoid last-minute technical issues.

Yes! We encourage you to select up to 3 institution preferences in your application. Here's how it works:

  • Rank your preferences (1st, 2nd, 3rd choice)
  • Explain your interest in each institution
  • We'll do our best to match you with your top choice
  • Final placement depends on mentor availability and fit

Being flexible with your preferences increases your chances of placement. Many of our best success stories came from participants whose second or third choice turned out to be a perfect match!

Upcoming Events

Building Bridges 2026

Croatian biomedicine, city by city

Intimate evenings of 40–50 that connect Croatian professionals with a world-leading institution in their city.

Next up
Zurich · Boston · Washington DC
Three city editions are being scheduled for 2026 — register your interest to hear dates first.

Our Mission

Building Bridges connects Croatian biomedical professionals across the globe with leading institutions in their local cities. Through intimate networking events of 40-50 attendees, we create meaningful connections that advance careers and foster international collaboration.

Event Cities

We host events in strategic locations where Croatian diaspora meets world-leading institutions.

🇨🇭 Zurich (upcoming) 🇺🇸 Boston (upcoming) 🇺🇸 Washington DC (upcoming) 🇬🇧 London (past) 🇺🇸 New York (past)

Who Can Apply

Applications are open to Croatian biomedical professionals worldwide - researchers, physicians, industry professionals, and students pursuing advanced degrees at recognized institutions.

Event Format

Each event features keynote speakers from local institutions, structured networking sessions, and social activities. Events are typically held at prestigious venues with catering and professional facilitation.
